title: Project: E-commerce Order Engine
summary: Build a transactional order engine: exact integer money, discount and tax composition, and an all-or-nothing checkout over SQLite.

rubric.label: Correctness
rubric.description: Every visible and hidden test passes: money arithmetic, discount order, tax rounding, atomic checkout and idempotency.

rubric.label: Integrity
rubric.description: Stock can never go negative and a partially applied order can never be observed, even when a later item fails.
